timing: after Gate-0 contract CI passed, before DataSTOC response rows were fetched or inspected for EOG-WF
reason: The v1 contract's raw supporting-world-frequency log-loss is a valid set-valued forecast projection but does not by itself isolate predictive information carried by exact world identity. This amendment fixes that estimand before outcome access.

nonresponse_numerics.environment_standardisation: calibration-period mean and population standard deviation (ddof=0) per predictor; zero-SD predictor is a pre-model failure

identity_calibration.world_order: the fixed 20 world IDs in deterministic family/threshold order
identity_calibration.site_world_bit: 1 iff the world survived calibration reconstruction and supports the site by horizon 8; 0 otherwise
identity_calibration.frequency_feature: mean of site_world_bit over surviving worlds; if no world survives the species is calibration-falsified and not modeled
identity_calibration.frequency_model: L2 logistic regression fitted on 2006-2011 observed_in_period using intercept + frequency_feature; C=1.0, lbfgs, max_iter=2000, no class weights
identity_calibration.identity_model: L2 logistic regression fitted on 2006-2011 observed_in_period using intercept + frequency_feature + the ordered surviving-world bit columns; drop training-constant columns only; C=1.0, lbfgs, max_iter=2000, no class weights
identity_calibration.heldout_application: apply the fitted frequency and identity models unchanged to the 2012-2017 site forecast features

primary_identity_endpoint.species_direction_rule: identity model log loss < frequency model log loss
favourable_family_rule: at least 10 species estimable after the already-frozen species gate
at least 60% of estimable species have a negative species contrast

external_prediction_endpoint.primary_external_reference: fixed equal-weight mean of the already-frozen environment-only L2 logistic and random-forest SDM probabilities
external_prediction_endpoint.additional_guardrail: identity_model must not be worse than the already-frozen persistence baseline on species-macro log loss

report: heldout positive rate by robust/contingent/excluded class
heldout positive enrichment of robust vs excluded class when both classes contain >=10 heldout sites
number of equal-frequency collision levels containing multiple exact world-bit identities
heldout positive-rate spread across exact identities within those collision levels, descriptive only
raw_set_valued_endpoints.claim_boundary: These diagnose the set-valued forecast. Confirmatory identity predictive value is determined only by the predeclared identity-vs-frequency heldout log-loss contrast above.

forbidden_after_response_open: select world-bit columns using heldout outcomes
replace the external reference after seeing results
